description: Start, update, or end a live progress card on the room members' lock screen (an iOS Live Activity / Android live update). Reuse the same correlation_id for every ping of one stream: the first ping starts the card and sends one alert, further "running" pings move it silently, and the first "done"/"failed" sends one completion alert and ends it. Free accounts get a small number of NEW streams per day; updates and the final ping of an open stream are never charged; a first ping that is already "done"/"failed" counts as a new stream.

action.description: Quick-action slot to attribute the stream to (supplies the icon and sound).

correlation_id.description: The stream key. Reuse it on every ping of the same stream.

data.description: Arbitrary structured context (max 25 keys / 8KB), returned on read surfaces after connector privacy filtering. Do not put secrets in data.

live_status.description: The live card's state. Only state is required.

accent_override.description: Hex #rrggbb; a semantic accent for one frame (e.g. deadline red).

category.description: Legacy rendering category; prefer template. "alert" has NO template equivalent and is the only way to start a stream time-sensitive (breaks through Focus). Fixed at stream creation.

center.description: Center score/clock for the matchup template.

current_step.description: Index into steps; the only mutable steps field.

deadline_at.description: Epoch seconds the countdown template counts down to.

duration_seconds.description: Original countdown duration in seconds. Set on creation; preserved through updates and completion.

eta_at.description: Epoch seconds; renders a live ETA on status/progress.

left.description: Left side {label,value} for the matchup template.

metrics.description: Up to 3 {label,value} counters for the metrics template.

options.description: Up to 4 {value,label} choices for the question template.

prompt.description: The ask, for the question template.

right.description: Right side {label,value} for the matchup template.

state.description: running keeps the card live; done/failed end it with one completion alert.

steps.description: Step labels. Required on the first ping of a steps stream; immutable afterwards.

template.description: Which layout the OS renders. Fixed at stream creation.

requires_ack.description: Add an Acknowledge button; the first eligible member to tap resolves it for everyone. Does not raise the interruption level — set category "alert" for a time-sensitive start.

title.description: Card title. Defaults to the selected quick action's label.

name: live_status

result.description: Purpose-built PingRoom result with credential and account fields removed.
